Health, Armor and Luck have `z-index: 2` (`emotes.css`); Jade, Burn, Toxic, Tipsy and Credits have none (`apps/web/src/game/board.css`, the `.hero-portrait .hero-jade` to `.hero-credits` rules). - **Tipsy is always covered.** Health is always drawn (`apps/web/src/emotes/Portrait.tsx`), at the lower right: bottom -4px, 22px tall, 26px on a phone, 32px from 761 by 501 up.
